signal: Zeitview raised a $60M Series D in March 2025 and acquired Insight M in January 2026, expanding its AI aerial inspection platform across energy and infrastructure in 60+ countries.

email.body1:
Scott, saw Zeitview raised a $60M Series D and acquired Insight M to expand your aerial inspection platform.

Scaling that fast, especially into telecom enterprise, usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before momentum cools, and that is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Zeitview off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Scott, quick follow-up for Zeitview.

Post-raise and post-acquisition, the telecom pipeline target usually climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings your telecom segment needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Scott, last bit of proof for Zeitview.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Zeitview's reply rate likely compares to other infrastructure-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Scott, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling telecom pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch from raise to acquisition integration is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your telecom enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to Zeitview either way.
